'''Dono''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] who served the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
After the [[King/Legends|King]] of Onderon, [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], allied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a woman named Dono joined the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]],<ref name="War on 2 Fronts" /> made up by patriots who refused to recognize the legitimacy of the monarch.<ref name="SWE-dalgo">{{SWE|characters|dalgo|dalgo}}</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Onderon date" /> she was present with [[Hutch/Legends|Hutch]] and [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] when [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] arrived with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], whose goal was to train the rebels to fight off the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. While Rex was training the group to disable an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]], Saw was pushing her on to hurry.<ref name="War on 2 Fronts" />

After Saw Gerrera devised his own plan in rescuing King Dendup alone, Dono was ordered by Steela to follow him. The plan failed when the Separatists captured him, forcing Dono to return to the rebels and inform the terrible news. However, Steela refused to rescue him and decided to wait until tomorrow since she already devised her plan. When the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] tried to save the [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|real King of Onderon]] from his [[Death/Legends|execution]], Dono was killed by a blaster shot from a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] that hit her in the chest.<ref name="The Soft War" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dono is voiced by [[Nika Futterman]],<ref name="War on 2 Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> who also voices [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The character was named after [[Kris Donovan]], a [[Lucasfilm Animation]] staffer.<ref name=":0">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep503|text="Front Runners" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

Dono's hair model was the same used for [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name=":0" />
